info.title: mesh hub API
info.description: The HTTP API of `mesh hub`. Errors are JSON: { error, details? }. POST routes that write accept an idempotency key header for safe retries.

bearer.description: A token from `mesh login`, a machine token, or a service token.

session.name: mesh_session
session.description: The web dashboard's session (writes must come from the hub's own origin).

tags.name: daemon
tags.description: Used by `mesh up` on each machine.

get.summary: Liveness (kept for older clients; same as /healthz).
get.description: No authentication.

get.summary: Liveness: the process answers, with the hub's version, the schema it migrates to and its features (no database read).
get.description: No authentication.

get.summary: Readiness: the database answers and is migrated (503 until then); carries the hub's version.
get.description: No authentication.

get.summary: The login providers this hub offers.
get.description: No authentication.

post.summary: Log in with a token provider (or the Solo hub's local provider).
post.description: No authentication.

get.summary: Start a browser (OIDC) login: redirects to the identity provider.
get.description: No authentication.

parameters.description: cli | web

parameters.name: cli_port

parameters.name: cli_challenge

parameters.name: cli_mode
parameters.description: paste: the CLI can't receive a localhost redirect (a remote shell); the callback shows the one-time code to paste

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: machine name

get.summary: The identity provider's redirect back to the hub (a page with the one-time code for a CLI in paste mode).

post.summary: Exchange a CLI login code (with its PKCE verifier) for a token.

get.summary: What needs the calling user: questions, gates, stalled steps. With team=1: every open item of the team in one read (TeamAttention).
get.description: Any logged-in user (bearer token or web session). Also service tokens with the scope `goals:read`.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: 1: every open item of the team (a service with goals:read, or an admin); a service must send it

parameters.name: needsYouMs
parameters.description: team form: 60000-604800000, default 1800000 (the stuck-session floor)

parameters.name: turns
parameters.description: team form: 1-10000, default 40 (the stuck-step floor)

parameters.name: trial
parameters.description: team form: exclude (default) or include

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: team form: 1-5000, default 2000

get.summary: Server-sent hints (changed, wake). Lossy by design: clients refetch.

200.description: Server-sent events: hello, changed, wake, ping.

parameters.name: topic

parameters.name: pulses
parameters.description: 1: also goals created by pulses (left out by default)

post.summary: Check a preset and params as pulse create would (a read: a POST only because the preset text is long; it writes nothing, takes no idempotency key and emits no event): ok, the problems with create's texts, the warnings, and when ok the instantiated steps and the roster pins.

get.summary: Run cards of a pulse, newest first: one per slot, with stages (times, runs, cost), fold, item states now, dispositions, reports, sinks and the delta against the previous complete run.

parameters.name: trial
parameters.description: exclude (default), include or only

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1-100, default 20

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: the next of the previous page

get.summary: Health scorecard per pulse and a total over a window: slots, blockedBy, runs and waste parts, goals, accepted items, cost per accepted item, open debriefs and calibrations, findings by severity.
get.description: Any logged-in user (bearer token or web session). Also service tokens with the scope `goals:read`.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: 1-90, default 7

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: only pulses that run in this repo

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: only pulses with this topic

parameters.name: trial
parameters.description: exclude (default) or include

get.summary: Findings roll-up per preset and repo: items open (open or confirmed) and accepted now by severity S1-S4, over the lineages audited in the window, with the newest report artifact, the pulse and the preset's kind.
get.description: Any logged-in user (bearer token or web session). Also service tokens with the scope `goals:read`.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: 1-365, default 30: lineages with a raising record in [now - days, now]

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: only rows of this repo (the items' target repo)

parameters.name: preset
parameters.description: only rows of this preset

parameters.name: trial
parameters.description: exclude (default) or include

get.summary: Efficiency card of a goal and each step (all time): milliseconds per session state (working, needs_you, idle, stalled; absent when no session reported any), per session, turns, rounds, fails, parks, commits, take-overs, fix cycles, first-try pass, wall time, headless run totals.
get.description: Any logged-in user (bearer token or web session). Also service tokens with the scope `goals:read`.

get.summary: Efficiency figures inside a window (state time apportioned per UTC day), per goal, per repo and in total.
get.description: Any logged-in user (bearer token or web session). Also service tokens with the scope `goals:read`.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: 1-90 whole UTC days up to now (default 7); not with since/until

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: window start, ms or ISO time (default until - 7 days)

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: window end, exclusive, ms or ISO time (default now)

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: only steps in this repo

parameters.name: trial
parameters.description: exclude (default) or include

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: 1: per-step rows under each goal

get.summary: Stuck signal: sessions in needs_you longer than a threshold, claimed steps with many turns since their last commit, a per-repo count.

parameters.name: turns

parameters.name: repo

parameters.name: trial
